about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Shuizhu Yu Sichuan Poached Fish in Chilli Oil
recipes.summary: Tender fish slices poached in a numbing chilli broth over bean sprouts, served with steamed rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Toss the fish with the egg white, cornflour and a pinch of salt and chill while you make the broth.
Blanch the bean sprouts in boiling water for 1 minute until just wilted and spread in a deep bowl.
Fry the chilli bean paste, garlic and ginger in 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes until the oil reddens, add the stock and bring to a simmer.
Slide in the fish and poach for 3 minutes until opaque, then ladle over the sprouts.
Fry the dried chillies and peppercorns in the remaining oil for 30 seconds until they darken and pour the hot oil over the fish.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and the thickest part reaches 63°C. Contains egg, gluten, soy and fish. Keep any leftover garlic, herb or chilli oil in the fridge and use it within 4 days.

recipes.title: Xiang La Xia Hunan Chilli Prawns
recipes.summary: Fast Hunan stir-fried prawns with fresh and dried chilli, garlic and a splash of black vinegar.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, add the dried chillies for 20 seconds until they darken, then the garlic, ginger and fresh chilli for 30 seconds.
Add the prawns and stir-fry for 3 minutes until pink and curled.
Splash in the soy sauce, vinegar and sugar and toss for 1 minute until glazed, then scatter the spring onions and serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until opaque and pink (63°C inside), and keep raw prawns chilled.

recipes.title: Teochew Steamed Fish with Tomato and Ginger
recipes.summary: Silky white fish steamed with tomato, ginger, vinegar and mushrooms in a light savoury broth.

items: 4 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and sliced

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Lay the fish in a heatproof dish and scatter over the tomatoes, mushrooms, vinegar, ginger and soy sauce.
Steam over boiling water for 10 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Heat the vegetable and sesame oils until shimmering and pour over the spring onions on top.
Serve with the juices spooned over the rice.
notes: Food safety: steam the fish until the thickest part reaches 63°C. Naturally dairy-free.

recipes.title: Nikujaga Japanese Beef and Potato Simmer
recipes.summary: Thin beef, potato and onion simmered in sweet soy dashi, a homestyle Japanese comfort dinner.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the oil in a pot and fry the beef for 3 minutes until just browned, then add the onions and cook for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the potatoes, carrots, dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar and bring to a gentle boil until the pot is bubbling steadily.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the liquid has reduced by half.
Stir in the peas for 2 minutes until hot, then serve in bowls with rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C throughout, and wash hands after handling raw beef.

recipes.title: Tonkatsu with Shredded Cabbage and Rice
recipes.summary: Crumbed pork cutlets fried until golden, with cabbage, rice and tangy tonkatsu sauce.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Season the pork, dust with flour, dip in the egg and press into the panko.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and fry the cutlets for 4 minutes each side until deep golden and cooked through.
Rest on a rack for 3 minutes, slice and serve with the cabbage, sauce, lemon and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C in the centre. Contains egg, wheat, soy and shellfish.

recipes.title: Haemul Pajeon Korean Seafood Pancake
recipes.summary: Crisp spring onion pancakes studded with prawns and squid, served with a soy and vinegar dip.
steps: Whisk the plain flour, rice flour, egg, water and a pinch of salt into a thin batter.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a non-stick pan and lay a quarter of the spring onions in a row.
Pour over a quarter of the batter and scatter with seafood, then cook for 4 minutes until the base is crisp and golden.
Flip and cook for 3 minutes until the seafood is opaque, repeating for the other pancakes.
Mix the soy sauce, vinegar and gochugaru and serve as a dip.
notes: Food safety: cook seafood until opaque and reaching 63°C, and eggs until set. Contains egg, wheat, soy and shellfish.

recipes.title: Pad Prik King Thai Green Bean Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Pork mince and snake beans fried in red curry paste with kaffir lime leaf, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Fry the curry paste in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant and the oil separates.
Add the pork mince and cook for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through.
Add the beans, fish sauce, sugar and 1/4 cup water and stir-fry for 4 minutes until the beans are tender-crisp, then fold in the lime leaves.
Serve the pork and beans straight from the wok over the steaming rice, with extra lime leaf if you like.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.

recipes.title: Gaeng Keow Wan Gai Thai Green Chicken Curry
recipes.summary: Creamy green curry with chicken thigh, aubergine and basil, simmered in coconut milk.

items: 600g chicken thighs, boneless and skinless, sliced

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Fry the paste in the oil for 2 minutes until fragrant, add half the coconut milk and cook until the oil splits.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes until sealed, then the remaining milk, eggplant, fish sauce and sugar.
Simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the eggplant is soft, add the beans for 3 minutes and stir in the basil.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece, and wash hands after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Khao Soi Gai Chiang Mai Chicken Curry Noodles
recipes.summary: Northern Thai coconut curry noodles with chicken, crisp noodles, pickled mustard greens and lime.

items: 600g chicken thighs, boneless and skinless, sliced

steps: Cook 100g of the noodles in hot oil for 1 minute until puffed and crisp, and boil the rest for 3 minutes until tender, then drain.
Fry the curry paste and turmeric in 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk and cook for 3 minutes until the oil rises, then add the stock, fish sauce and sugar.
Add the chicken and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through and tender.
Divide the noodles among bowls, ladle over the curry and top with crisp noodles, greens, shallots and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Contains egg, wheat, fish and shellfish.

recipes.title: Bun Rieu Style Tomato Tofu Noodles
recipes.summary: Rice vermicelli in a sour tomato broth with fried tofu, herbs and a spoon of shrimp paste.
steps: Cook the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender, then drain and rinse.
Fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden, then lift out.
Fry the shallots in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until soft, add the tomatoes and cook for 6 minutes until they collapse.
Add the stock, tamarind, fish sauce and shrimp paste and simmer for 10 minutes until fragrant.
Divide the noodles among bowls, add the tofu and ladle over the broth, then top with sprouts, mint and lime.
notes: Contains fish sauce, shrimp paste, so not vegetarian and soy.

recipes.title: Thit Heo Quay Vietnamese Crispy Pork Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Crackling-topped roast pork belly sliced over rice with pickled cucumber and nuoc cham.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Pat the pork dry, prick the skin, rub the meat with five spice and the skin with salt and vinegar.
Roast at 160°C for 60 minutes until the meat is tender, then raise to 230°C for 15 minutes until the skin is blistered and crisp.
Mix the fish sauce, sugar, lime juice and chilli with 3 tbsp water for the dipping sauce.
Rest the pork for 10 minutes, slice and serve with rice, cucumber and sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C in the centre. Wash hands and boards after handling raw pork.

recipes.title: Mi Quang Danang Turmeric Noodles
recipes.summary: Wide rice noodles with turmeric prawns and pork in a little rich broth, with peanuts and herbs.
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 8 minutes until tender, then drain.
Fry the shallots, turmeric and pork in the oil for 6 minutes until the pork is browned and cooked through.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes, pour in the stock and fish sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Divide the noodles among bowls and ladle over a little broth, then top with peanuts, mint and sprouts.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork to 75°C and the prawns until opaque and pink.

recipes.title: Ca Ri Ga Vietnamese Chicken Curry
recipes.summary: Chicken, potato and carrot braised in a mild coconut curry with lemongrass.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Fry the onion, garlic and curry powder in the oil for 5 minutes until fragrant, add the chicken and brown for 5 minutes.
Add the lemongrass, coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar and 1 cup water.
Simmer for 15 minutes, add potatoes and carrots and cook for 15 minutes until tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Spoon the curry over the cooked rice and serve while the sauce is still hot and glossy.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C at the bone, and wash hands after handling raw chicken.

recipes.title: Opor Ayam Javanese Coconut Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken simmered in a mild, creamy coconut gravy with galangal, lemongrass and candlenut.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, coriander and turmeric into a paste and fry in the oil for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken and brown for 5 minutes, then the lemongrass, bay leaves, coconut milk, salt and 1/2 cup water.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is tender and the sauce is thick.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C at the bone.

recipes.title: Sate Ayam Indonesian Peanut Chicken Skewers
recipes.summary: Grilled turmeric chicken skewers with a sweet peanut sauce, served on rice with cucumber.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Mix the turmeric, kecap manis and oil and coat the chicken, then thread onto metal skewers.
Grill or pan-fry for 12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Warm the peanut butter, lime juice, garlic, sambal and 1/2 cup water in a pot for 3 minutes until smooth and pourable.
Serve over rice with cucumber.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C, and wash hands after handling raw chicken. Contains peanuts, gluten and soy.

recipes.title: Kari Kapitan Nyonya Chicken Curry
recipes.summary: Nyonya style chicken curry with lemongrass, galangal, tamarind and coconut milk.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Blend the shallots, garlic, chillies, ginger and turmeric into a paste and fry in the oil for 6 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken and lemongrass and cook for 5 minutes, then the coconut milk, tamarind, sugar, salt and 1/2 cup water.
Simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is thick.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C at the bone.

recipes.title: Udang Asam Tamarind Prawns
recipes.summary: Sticky tamarind prawns with chilli and curry leaves, served over rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the garlic, chillies and curry leaves for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the prawns and stir-fry for 3 minutes until pink.
Add the tamarind, sugar, soy sauce and 1/4 cup water and cook for 2 minutes until sticky and glossy, then serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until opaque and pink (63°C inside), and keep raw prawns chilled.

recipes.title: Pinakbet Filipino Mixed Vegetable Stew with Pork
recipes.summary: Okra, eggplant, squash and beans stewed with pork and a salty fermented shrimp paste.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Fry the pork in the oil for 8 minutes until browned, then the onion, garlic and tomatoes for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the shrimp paste and 1 cup water, add the pumpkin and eggplant and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the okra and beans and cook for 6 minutes until tender, then serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork to 75°C.

recipes.title: Lumpiang Shanghai Filipino Spring Roll Plates
recipes.summary: Crisp pork and carrot rolls served with sweet chilli sauce and rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Mix the pork, carrot, onion, garlic, egg and soy sauce until well combined.
Roll a spoonful in each wrapper and seal the edge with water.
Fry in the oil in batches for 5 minutes until deep golden and cooked through.
Serve with chilli sauce and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the rolls until the centre reaches 75°C. Contains egg, wheat and soy.

recipes.title: Goan Xitt Kodi Fish Curry with Rice
recipes.summary: Coconut and tamarind fish curry with kokum and red chilli, as made in Goan homes.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Blend the onions, chillies, coriander and turmeric with a little water to a paste and fry in the oil for 6 minutes until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, tamarind, salt and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 8 minutes.
Lay in the fish and cook for 6 minutes until opaque and flaking, then serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until the thickest part reaches 63°C. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Chettinad Mushroom Pepper Fry
recipes.summary: Mushrooms fried with black pepper, fennel and curry leaves, served with rice and yoghurt.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the oil, add fennel, cumin and curry leaves for 30 seconds, then the onions and cook for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, mushrooms and salt and cook for 8 minutes until browned and the liquid has gone.
Add the tomatoes and pepper and cook for 4 minutes until dry, then serve with rice and yoghurt.
notes: Vegetarian. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Chickpea and Bean Curry with Roasted Curry Powder
recipes.summary: A dark, spicy Sri Lankan curry of chickpeas, beans and coconut, cooked with roasted curry powder.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Fry the onion, garlic and curry leaf in the oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the curry powder and turmeric for 1 minute, then the chickpeas, coconut milk, tamarind and 1/2 cup water.
Simmer for 15 minutes, add the beans and cook for 8 minutes until tender and the sauce is thick.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Wok-Roasted Tomato and Ginger Chicken Peshawar Style
recipes.summary: Chicken cooked in a wok with tomato, ginger and green chilli until the oil rises.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the ghee in a wok, fry the cumin, garlic, ginger and chicken for 8 minutes until browned.
Add the tomatoes, salt and pepper, cover and cook for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender and the oil separates.
Stir in the chillies and garam masala for 3 minutes and finish with coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C at the bone. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Nepali Chicken Choila
recipes.summary: Charred chicken tossed with ginger, garlic, cumin and mustard oil in the Newari style.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Grill the chicken for 14 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Cool for 3 minutes, chop and toss with the oil, ginger, garlic, spices, onion, chillies and lime juice.
Fold in the coriander and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Naturally gluten-free and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Chingri Malaikari Bengali Coconut Prawn Curry
recipes.summary: Bengali prawns in a creamy coconut gravy with ginger, cardamom and bay leaf.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the oil, fry the bay leaves, cardamom and onions for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the ginger, turmeric, chilli, sugar and salt for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 6 minutes until thick, then add the prawns and cook for 4 minutes until pink and opaque.
Spoon the curry over the cooked rice and serve while the sauce is still hot and glossy.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until opaque and pink (63°C). Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Doi Maach Bengali Yoghurt Fish Curry
recipes.summary: Fish fillets simmered in a spiced yoghurt gravy with turmeric and ginger.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Fry the onions in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, add the ginger and spices.
Stir in the yoghurt, sugar, salt and 1/2 cup water on low heat for 3 minutes.
Add the fish and simmer gently for 8 minutes until opaque and flaking, then serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until the thickest part reaches 63°C. Contains dairy and fish.

recipes.title: Shiro Wat Ethiopian Chickpea Flour Stew
recipes.summary: Silky chickpea flour stew with onion, garlic and paprika, served over rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Fry the onions in a dry pot for 8 minutes, then add the oil, garlic and ginger for 2 minutes.
Add the paprika, cumin and tomato paste for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Whisk in the stock and chickpea flour, simmer for 10 minutes, stirring, until thick and smooth, then serve over rice.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mukimo Kenyan Mashed Potato Peas and Greens
recipes.summary: Comforting Kenyan mash of potato, peas, corn and spinach, served with a tomato stew.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add tomatoes and cook for 6 minutes, then add tofu and salt for 4 minutes.
Wilt the spinach in the hot pot for 2 minutes until soft.
Mash potatoes with butter, corn and spinach until chunky and serve with the stew.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Potjiekos South African Lamb and Vegetable Stew
recipes.summary: A layered lamb stew with potatoes, carrots and cabbage simmered slowly in a heavy pot.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes until deep golden, then lift out.
Fry the onions, garlic and curry powder for 4 minutes until soft.
Return the lamb with the stock, salt and carrots and simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cabbage and cook for 30 minutes until the lamb is very tender and the sauce has thickened.
notes: Food safety: cook lamb until it reaches 75°C.

recipes.title: Peri-Peri Chicken with Rice and Slaw
recipes.summary: Roast chicken in a fiery peri-peri marinade, with rice and a quick cabbage slaw.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Blend the chillies, garlic, oil, lemon juice, paprika, salt and oregano and coat the chicken.
Roast at 200°C for 35 minutes until deep golden and cooked through.
Toss cabbage and carrot with a spoon of the marinade and serve with the chicken and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken until it reaches 75°C at the bone. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Rourou Fijian Taro Leaf Coconut Curry
recipes.summary: Taro leaves, or spinach, simmered in coconut milk with onion and chilli, served with rice and chickpeas.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Fry the onion, garlic, ginger and chillies in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the turmeric, chickpeas, coconut milk and salt and simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thick.
Stir in the spinach for 4 minutes until tender and serve with rice.
notes: Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Poisson Cru Tahitian Fish in Coconut and Lime
recipes.summary: Raw-style Tahitian fish dish, here lightly poached, with lime, coconut milk and crisp vegetables.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Poach the fish in simmering water for 3 minutes until just opaque, then drain and cool.
Toss with lime juice and salt, leave for 10 minutes, then add the diced vegetables.
Fold in the coconut milk and spring onions and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and 63°C.

recipes.title: Kalua Pork Rice Bowls with Pineapple
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked Hawaiian pulled pork with pineapple and cabbage over rice.
steps: Rub the pork with salt and smoked paprika and place in a covered pot with 1/2 cup water.
Cook at 160°C for 3 hours until fork tender.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Shred the pork, return to the juices and serve over rice with cabbage and pineapple.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C in the thickest part.
